import random
import string

def generate_test_case():
    m = random.randint(1, 1000)       # length of string s
    n = random.randint(1, m)            # length of string t
    
    # All uppercase and lowercase English letters
    alphabet = string.ascii_letters   
    
    s = ''.join(random.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(m))
    t = ''.join(random.choice(s) for _ in range(n)) # Ensures string t has characters from string s

    return s, t
